description.ja: 境界、接触、履歴、返りから、認識・意味・倫理・AI・社会へ。まず表現面に触れることも、正式な入口から入ることも、体系・応用・研究から読むこともできます。
description.en: Move from boundaries, contact, history, and return toward cognition, meaning, ethics, AI, and society. You may begin with an expressive encounter, a canonical entrance, the core system, applications, or research.

description.ja: 個別理論へ入る前に、概念と文書の接続、体系図、運用方針、研究動態、主張強度、物理近接語彙の接続条件を見渡す案内層。
description.en: An orientation layer for seeing concept-document connections, system maps, operational policy, research dynamics, claim strength, and conditions for physics-adjacent terminology before entering individual theories.

description.ja: ネットワーク構造そのものと、存在・接触・観測・意味・知がどのように成立しうるかを扱う基礎層。
description.en: The foundation layer for network structure itself and for the conditions under which existence, contact, observation, meaning, and knowledge can arise.

subtitle.ja: 履歴・差分・読みの生成
subtitle.en: History, difference, and the generation of reading

description.ja: ネットワークを流れる通信内容と、その受け取られ方・読み方の生成を扱う。事象流、履歴、差分、注意、抽象化、認識軸形成へ進む層。
description.en: The layer for communication content moving through the network and for how reception and reading are generated, including event streams, history, difference, attention, abstraction, and cognitive-axis formation.

description.ja: 通信を成立させる規約と、その管理を扱う。受容・保留・停止、通約、仮閉鎖、残差、異議、責任、返送を読む層。
description.en: The layer for protocols that make communication possible and for their management: acceptance, suspension, stopping, commensuration, provisional closure, residuals, objections, responsibility, and return.

subtitle.ja: 理論をスピンアウトし、実践から残差を返す
subtitle.en: Spin out theory and return residuals from practice

description.ja: 01–03の元型と、必要に応じて05の批判・拡張を、AI・心理・経済・政治・制度・設計へ持ち出す応用層。実践で生じた残差は05または該当する正本所有文書へ返す。
description.en: The application layer that carries the 01–03 archetype, and where useful critiques or extensions from 05, into AI, psychology, economics, politics, institutions, and design. Residuals from practice return to 05 or the relevant concept owner.

subtitle.ja: 元型を共有文法の内側から批判・拡張する
subtitle.en: Critique and extend the archetype from within

description.ja: 01–03を存在境界論の共有文法の内側から批判・拡張し、強い仮説、分野横断対応、形式化候補、未解決残差を返路付きで保持する研究層。配置は重要性や成熟度の低さを意味しない。
description.en: The research layer that critiques and extends 01–03 from within Scientific Ontology’s shared grammar, retaining stronger hypotheses, cross-domain correspondences, formalization candidates, and unresolved residuals with return paths. Placement here does not imply lower importance or maturity.

subtitle.ja: 01–05をレンダリングし、保持と損失を測る
subtitle.en: Render 01–05 and track what is preserved or lost

description.ja: 01–05の構造を図・配置・知覚的表現へレンダリングする研究面。図を理論本文の代替にせず、変換で保持されたものと失われた条件を本文へ返して照合する。
description.en: A rendering-research surface that projects structures from 01–05 into diagrams, layouts, and perceptual forms. It does not replace source texts; it returns what the transformation preserved or lost for re-collation.

label.ja: 外部との接触・表現・再照合

subtitle.ja: 共有文法の外へ曝露し、反論と残差を受け取る
subtitle.en: Expose the archetype beyond the shared grammar and receive objections and residuals

description.ja: とくに01–03を、存在境界論の共有文法を前提としない異質な対象・価値体系・言語・表現形式・反論へ曝露する外部接触面。理解不能、通約失敗、前提衝突、反論、反証候補、適用限界を区別して受け取り、05・04・06または正本所有文書へ返す。
description.en: An external-contact surface that exposes especially 01–03 to heterogeneous subjects, values, languages, expressive forms, and objections that do not presuppose Scientific Ontology’s shared grammar. It distinguishes incomprehension, failed commensuration, premise conflict, objections, candidate refutations, and limits of application, then returns residuals to 05, 04, 06, or the relevant concept owner.

purpose.ja: 体系の開始線、公開上の姿勢、v5系でどこへ進むのかを最初に読む。
purpose.en: Start with the opening line, public stance, and where the v5 series is going.

purpose.ja: 境界事件、作用、返り、責任分界、可動性という短い運用線から全体へ入る。
purpose.en: Enter through the compact operational line of boundary events, action, return, responsibility partition, and mobility.

purpose.ja: 概念体系、公開体系、リポジトリ体系の三つの面から、各層と公開境界の配置を俯瞰する。
purpose.en: Survey layer placement and public boundaries across the conceptual, publication, and repository architectures.

label.ja: 概念のつながりを見る

purpose.ja: 概念の一覧ではなく、文書所有、読解経路、返路、アポリアを含むネットワークとして全体を読む。
purpose.en: Read the system as a network of document ownership, reading routes, return paths, and aporia rather than as a flat concept list.

purpose.ja: 標準表記、英語通約、公開上の注意を確認し、詳細定義を所有する文書へ戻る。
purpose.en: Check standard forms, English commensurations, and public-handling notes, then return to the documents that own detailed definitions.

description.ja: いま前に出して読んでもらいたい文書を、編集者が選ぶ枠です。
description.en: An editor-selected space for the documents to put forward now.

description.ja: 読書の流れを作るために、任意の文書を並べられます。
description.en: A curated sequence of documents for shaping a reading route.

description.ja: 近い概念だけを巡回しないために、離れた文書を意図的に置ける枠です。
description.en: A place for deliberately distant documents so reading does not stay inside one conceptual neighborhood.
